maptrivialLift.name: LValueData.map_trivialLift
maptrivialLift.statement:
lemma LValueData.map_trivialLift {P s} n [Fintype n] (S : LevelPlaces (E P s)) (hψ :
  IsEmpty S.TwistIndex) (σ : Gal(ℂ/K P)) : ∃ t l u, ‖t‖ = (√(P.bigOmega s))⁻¹ ∧ l ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ {X :
  LValueData _ n} {e μ ψ m} is unr, X.1 = S → let Y := (mk X.1 (X.jetDeg <|
    e.symm ·) μ ψ is X.one_lt_card unr); Fintype.card n = 2 * m → placePerm s σ = e → (∀ u, u.1.1 =
    1 → μ.1 u = σ (X.μ.1 u)) → ∀ h i, σ ((P.jetScale s ^ (∑ τ, X.jetDeg τ) • X.trivialLift) h i) =
    (t ^ ∑ τ, X.jetDeg τ) * (l * Y.auxPair.b.1 u) * multiplierRatio σ (onHom (s :=
    X.auxPair.signs) (s' := 1) (1, 1, h)).2 * Y.trivialLift h (i <| e.symm ·)

    b u) μ [Nonempty p] (A : (hypSum Unit X).Splitting W p) [IsBaseAdapted A] (V : Space E r t) (σ :

  k' k₁ d Φ₁') σ (hs : negCount (s₁ ⊕ᵥ s₂) = negCount s' + negCount s) e (he : card n' =
  card n + 2 * e) (hn : 2 * negCount (s₁ ⊕ᵥ s₂) + 2 ≤ card (n₁ ⊕ n₂)) {μ : _ → ℤ} (hμ : ∀ v, card
  (n₁ ⊕ n₂) ≤ 2 * μ v + 2 * negCount (s₁ ⊕ᵥ s₂)) (ht : ∀ i, IsTameFor (𝔪 i) (ν i) μ (χ i)) (hE :
  ∀ i {p q} [Fintype p] [Fintype q], card p + card q = card n₁ + card n₂ → a i p * b i q = rankTwist
  (ν i)⁻¹ (n₁ ⊕ n₂)) : let u i x := modDescent _ A (b i) Φ₂ (Pi.single x.toCols₂ 1) _ _ ∘ₗ modLift

  ∃ C κ, ∀ i, ∃ c ≠ 0, ‖c‖ ^ 2 = C * lValueProd (𝔪 i).places (ν i) e ∧
